title: The Permission *Layer*
dek: OpenAI's first $10B quarter. Anthropic's $17B at 20x better economics. The access layer of the AI stack is being built simultaneously at every altitude.

stories.label: OpenAI Q3 revenue, vs Anthropic's $17B in the same quarter
stories.headline: OpenAI hits $10B. Anthropic posts $17B at a $567M loss. The gap is structural.
Every data platform with enterprise contracts is now also an AI assistant company.

stories.label: CoreWeave's contracted backlog, on $3.66B in Q3 2026 revenue
stories.headline: A $132.5B backlog is committed infrastructure spend. The bubble thesis depends on whether it stays.

stories.label: humanoid AI anchors live at the World Media Summit, Beijing
stories.headline: China's state agency put humanoid anchors on stage. Who controls the vetted source list?

stories.label: Apollo 2 task success at Mercedes-Benz, running Gemini Robotics 2.5
stories.headline: 96% task success in a live factory deployment. The humanoid threshold is now a business case.
Nvidia's board opens an independent investigation into its own CEO. The chips keep shipping.

stories.label: major platforms blocking AI agents from customer-delegated access
stories.headline: The platforms blocking agents assert their design preferences outrank the customer's tool choice.

still_signal: The revenue gap, the hardware backlog, the board probe, the blocked agents: the access layer of the AI stack is being designed simultaneously, at every altitude, with no shared framework.
